text: Besides, your father will come home. We must let Fred go alone. He can tell Mary that you are here, and she will come back to-morrow.” Christy glanced at his own threadbare knees, and then at Fred’s beautiful white trousers. Certainly Fred’s tailoring suggested the advantages of an English university, and he had a graceful way even of looking warm and of pushing his hair back with his handkerchief. “Children, run away,” said Mrs. Garth; “it is too warm to hang about your friends.
